Lemon Squeezy is winding down. Over the last two years, we’ve taken everything we learned and built Managed Payments, Stripe’s merchant of record solution.

We care about supporting as many businesses as possible. We also want to offer an excellent product and rapidly ship improvements: increasingly, the best way to do so is by offering a single product instead of running two platforms.

Lemon Squeezy closed new store sign-ups today and we’ll stop processing payments on March 31, 2027. We know this is disruptive. We’re reaching out to all businesses using Lemon Squeezy and sharing next steps specific to their business. Our support team is here to help throughout the transition.

To every founder, developer, and creator who built with us, thank you.
